gloss: bunch, cluster, (botany) truss (a group of a number of similar things)
duel (combat between two persons, often over a matter of honor)
shawl (a square piece of cloth worn as a covering for the head, neck, and shoulders)
a large bottle; carboy, demijohn, flask
periodical wrapper, post package, small parcel
crystal, cut glass, lead glass (glass with a high refractive index, used for making fine glassware; by extension, fine glassware made of such glass)
bill of credit, bill of exchange, promissory note
socle (plinth, i.e. thickened bottom part of a wall or pedestal, often used to display art work)
plug (device for connecting a machine to main power)
libel, libelous or defamatory piece of journalism
slate pencil, stylus for writing on a slate board
table, tablet (with sacred text inscribed upon it)
coal (a black rock formed from prehistoric plant remains, composed largely of carbon and burned as a fuel)
stem, stalk (botany: above-ground stalk of a vascular plant)
main line, main route, main waterway (air, rail, nautical, automotive)
barrel (unit of liquid measure equal to one-quarter of a pipe)
facet, side (of an object with flat, sharply defined surfaces)
step (interval between two contiguous degrees of the scale)
shank, rod, pivot, spindle (straight round stick, shaft, or bar)
barley (annual temperate grasses of the species Hordeum vulgare or its grain used in making food and beverages)
fur, hair (animal hair or human body hair; contrast волосы and мех)
divine grace, boon, bliss (a blessing or benefit)
hollow of the hand, cupped hand
